newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE nearby wheat rebounds to end A$2.00/t up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE nearby wheat rebounds to end A$2.00/t up.

text.p: Nearby most-active Sydney wheat futures rebounded in light volume trading on Wednesday, reflecting a run-on from a firmer market tone in the U.S. overnight.
January and March each gained A$2.00 to settle at A$158.50 and A$160.50 a tonne respectively.
Traders chalked the gains up to a market correction of sorts after similar volumes of trading in the previous session lowered values by the same amount.

Comments by Australian Wheat Board chairman Trevor Flugge earlier on Wednesday that Austrtalia was likely to maintain exports to China at 2.2 million tonnes this year despite expectations of a strong Chinese crop were regarded as mildly supportive.

However, a recent upwardly revised AWB forecast of a 20 million tonne Australian crop in 1996/97 (April/March) -- making it the second highest on record -- is viewed as a stronger counter balance in the market, they said.
